name: aclipp
description: Work with your aclipp PR data in ChatGPT: media coverage, outlets, authors, analytics, AI visibility, reports and dashboards.

interface.longDescription:
aclipp is a European PR analytics platform. Communication teams and PR agencies use it to show what their work achieves, in media coverage and in AI answers.

With the aclipp plugin you can ask about your aclipp workspace in plain language:

- Find and read media coverage, filtered by date, channel, outlet, tag, country or sentiment.
- Analyze reach, coverage volume, sentiment and share of voice over time and against competitors.
- See how often AI assistants mention your brand and your competitors, and which sources they cite.
- Look up the outlets and journalists behind your coverage.
- Add coverage from a link, and create or update reports, dashboards, alerts, tags and AI visibility prompts.

You sign in with your aclipp account and choose which organizations and projects ChatGPT may access. Write access is only granted when you approve it on the consent screen. The plugin needs an aclipp workspace and only sees data your account can access. It does not email journalists or post on your behalf, and it asks for your confirmation before deleting anything.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my media coverage from the last 30 days.
How visible is my brand in AI answers compared to competitors?
Which outlets drove the most reach this quarter?

positive.prompt: How visible is Claude in AI answers compared to its competitors? Show visibility, share of voice and average position.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns visibility, share of voice and average position for Claude and its six tracked competitors, using only numbers returned by the tools.

positive.description: Find the sources AI answers cite
positive.prompt: Which domains do AI answers cite most often for our prompts, and which of them mention Claude?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks the cited domains by citation count and marks the ones whose pages mention Claude.

positive.description: Summarize media coverage by outlet reach
positive.prompt: Summarize our media coverage and show the top outlets by reach.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the clippings in the project and ranks outlets by reach from the returned data.

positive.description: Find the journalists who cover the brand most
positive.prompt: Which journalists wrote about Claude most often, and which outlets do they write for?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks authors by clipping count in the project and names their outlets from the returned data.

positive.prompt: Add this article to the project Claude: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-4-5
positive.expected_behavior: Submits the link and reports whether the import is processing, admitted, or rejected with the reason (for example a duplicate).

negative.description: General question unrelated to PR data
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for apple strudel?

negative.description: Sending emails to journalists is not supported
negative.prompt: Email my press release to all journalists who wrote about us last month.
Post a LinkedIn update about our coverage this month.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It requires an existing aclipp workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: media coverage, outlets, authors, analytics, AI visibility, reports, dashboards and alerts from your aclipp workspace.

de-DE.subtitle: PR-Monitoring und -Analyse
de-DE.description:
aclipp ist eine europäische PR-Analytics-Plattform. Kommunikationsteams und PR-Agenturen belegen damit, was ihre Arbeit bewirkt, in der Berichterstattung und in KI-Antworten.

Mit dem aclipp-Plugin fragst du deinen aclipp-Workspace in normaler Sprache:

- Clippings finden und lesen, gefiltert nach Zeitraum, Kanal, Medium, Tag, Land oder Tonalität.
- Reichweite, Anzahl der Beiträge, Tonalität und Share of Voice im Zeitverlauf und im Vergleich zu Mitbewerbern auswerten.
- Sehen, wie oft KI-Assistenten deine Marke und deine Mitbewerber nennen und welche Quellen sie zitieren.
- Die Medien und Journalist:innen hinter deiner Berichterstattung nachschlagen.
- Berichterstattung per Link hinzufügen sowie Reports, Dashboards, Alerts, Tags und AI-Visibility-Prompts anlegen und bearbeiten.

Du meldest dich mit deinem aclipp-Konto an und wählst, auf welche Organisationen und Projekte ChatGPT zugreifen darf. Schreibzugriff gibt es nur, wenn du ihn im Zustimmungsdialog freigibst. Das Plugin setzt einen aclipp-Workspace voraus und sieht nur Daten, auf die dein Konto Zugriff hat. Es versendet keine E-Mails an Journalist:innen und postet nichts in deinem Namen. Bevor es etwas löscht, fragt es dich um Bestätigung.
